best: Every block is titled with a short functional note and drawn as a clean left-to-right wired circuit (four-switch stage with shunts, filters, half bridges and inductor in path order; bucks; cell-tap RC ladder), with almost no text overlap.
worst: Gauge sheet routes about fifteen long parallel staircase wires into U101 that must be traced one by one, and the fuse F102 / heater FET Q104 are split apart and joined only by an auto-named label Net-(F102-HTR)

Power FETs (Q101/Q102, Q401/Q402 half bridges) are drawn as pin boxes rather than MOSFET symbols, and the MCU antenna pi match wraps backwards right-to-left under the module so it does not read as a pi network
Minor clutter and balance: stacked overlapping pin numbers at U401/U405 ground pads, pin-number/label collisions at IC edges, floating test points, and the 3V3 sheet leaves its lower half empty
